configuration.data:
kind: AdaptiveDialog
beginDialog:
  kind: OnEventActivity
  id: main
  eventName: Microsoft.PowerApps.Copilot.FeatureContextProvider
  actions:
    - kind: ParseValue
      id: tVuxGh
      variable: Global.PA_Copilot_FeatureSettings_Version
      valueType: String
      value: =If(!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.FeatureContextProvider_Version), Text(System.Activity.ChannelData.FeatureContextProvider_Version), "-1")

    - kind: ParseValue
      id: Iy6mll
      variable: Global.PA_Copilot_FeatureSettings
      valueType:
        kind: Table
        properties:
          Name: String
          Value: Boolean

      value: =If(!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.FeatureContextProvider), System.Activity.ChannelData.FeatureContextProvider, System.Activity.Value)
configuration.name: Feature Settings Context - Event Trigger
